prompt:

Image2 is approved identity/color authority; Image1 is only overall game mood. Do not introduce a warmer/reddish version of chef when moving. Fine cozy pixel art matching Image2, taupe fur, cream muzzle/hat/shirt, soft sage-green apron, pink ears/paws. Fixed upper-left gentle light. Use THIN SOFT WARM-BROWN selective contours, never heavy black ink, never dark silhouette halo. Eyes and mouth can be dark, but exterior contour must be soft brown and delicate. Whiskers thin single strands, not blurred dark smears. Exact same head/hat/ears/body/apron/tail colors and texture IN EVERY CELL, INCLUDING BETWEEN ACTIONS.
Canvas2048x3072. EXACT4columns6rows =24equal512x512cells, no lines, no labels. All frames fullbody, fixed frontal camera, fixedscale. Hat topY62, feetbaselineY448, footmidpointX240, bodyheight386px, skullwidth170px excludingears, headtorso ratio same as Image2. Never scale body to fill enlarged pointing-arm bounds. All visible pixelsX70..465,Y50..465, safe margin>=40px. Runtime paddedcell320x320 displayed220..380CSSpx. If internal output1024x1536, gridcells256square and ALL anchors halve exactly. Never auto-tight-crop. SAME canvas/foot alignment/palette in all24frames. Feet/hat/body stay still, NO sway/bounce/squash/zoom.
Read row-major. FIRST12frames (rows1-3) idle blink:1open eyes neutral bothpawsdown;2gentleopen;3eyelidsstartlower;4halfclosed;5nearlyclosed;6bothclosed;7closedrelaxed;8startopening;9halfopen;10nearlyopen;11open;12same neutral as1. Keep hands/torso/feet completely still; only actual eyelids animate.
NEXT12frames (rows4-6) welcome recommending viewer-RIGHT menu:13exact same neutral as1;14viewer-RIGHT elbow slightly bends;15same paw atbelly;16same paw near chest;17forearmhalfextends right;18forearmnearlyextends right;19palmopens invitingly right atshoulderheight;20happy small smile with samepoint;21relaxed wrist stillpointing;22armhalfdown;23almostdown;24EXACTsame neutral as1and13. ONLY the VIEWER-RIGHT arm moves; viewer-left staysdown. Natural continuous shoulder/elbow/wrist poses, same fur/apron/outline as idle, no sudden darkening or thick black lines. First/last neutral must match perfectly.
Pure flat solid MAGENTA#FF00FF background/gutters for extraction, no floor/shadow/furniture/menu/labels/text/gridlines. No gradients in magenta, no castshadow or dark/colored halo. No new props. Twentyfour distinct anatomical poses, no translated duplicate frames. Entire figure and tail complete. Strict6rows4columns. Keep every outline thin and warm-brown, every material color constant; these are more important than adding detail.

PRODUCTION CONSISTENCY CONTRACT (applies to every asset): Declare exact output canvas dimensions, equal cell dimensions when using a sprite grid, intended in-scene footprint, fixed projection/camera, light direction, pixel-cluster density and outline weight matching the scene reference. For animated subjects, lock the same model sheet across ALL actions: constant skull width, head-to-body ratio, torso length, costume seams, foot spacing and ground-contact baseline. First and last neutral poses must match the canonical idle geometry. Frame bounding boxes may grow only for moving limbs/props, NEVER enlarge or shrink the whole body to fill a cell. Use one common padded canvas; reserve at least 8 percent margins around the widest action, never crop ears/tail/furniture. No per-frame zoom, reframing, translation of a copied pose, squash/stretch, or automatic tight framing. Fixed props and furniture remain the same size and at the same anchors throughout. Define body height, head width, foot-center X and foot baseline Y numerically in each animation task. For scenes/UI/items, explicitly preserve aspect ratio, safe area, optical size, border thickness and reference pixel density across variants. Backgrounds fill all edges; UI nine-slice corners remain fixed; no baked-in labels or text. Inspect transition between idle and interaction, NOT just individual sheets. Size/anchor/style mismatch means reject and regenerate; a successful HTTP response is not visual approval. For visitors entering or leaving a scene, create an explicit approach/peek/emerge/settle sequence and a physically occluded exit. Start and end the complete loop in the SAME hidden state. Specify separate entry and exit directions: never replace entrance with reversed exit, fading, scaling, or a cut from invisible to a fully visible idle character. Validate the loop boundary as carefully as individual frames.
